classification.reason: The KB explicitly states that two identical charges on the same day is a billing error that must be escalated rather than resolved by the agent.

draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the trouble. Two charges of the exact same amount on the exact same day is not expected behavior for your Team plan billing, and it's not something I'm able to resolve directly from here — I've escalated your case to our billing team so they can investigate the duplicate charge and take the appropriate action on your account.

In the meantime, you can view both charges under Settings > Billing > Invoices to confirm the details (dates, amounts, and line items) — that record will help our billing team look into this faster.

You'll hear from us as soon as we have an update. Thanks for your patience.

Best,
Loopwise Support

verification.notes: Both citations are accurate and directly support the claims; reply correctly escalates without promising any refund/discount, and professional tone is maintained.
